entities.summary: Antoine de Pas, Marquis de Feuquières was a French writer and soldier, who served in the wars of Louis XIV. He was the son of diplomat Isaac de Pas de Feuquières and grandson of Isaac Manasses de Pas, Marquis de Feuquieres.
